summary.headline: Enemies of the King
summary.text: Astrological rules for determining a king’s enemies from malefic aspects to his significator, including origins among subjects, domestics, nobles, citizens, relatives, and rivals. The text then opens Chapter XXX on the power, places, strength, separation, and conjunction of the luminaries.
